text:
Battery telemetry in InfluxDB

The new home-battery line reports every 2 seconds. Write its telemetry to an InfluxDB bucket with 30-day retention.

충전기 전력 사용량 시계열 적재

충전기별 전력 사용량 시계열을 InfluxDB Cloud에 저장하고 Grafana로 조회합니다.

Raw telemetry firehose in Cassandra

Timescale struggles with the v4 board's write rate; store raw per-second telemetry in a Cassandra cluster and keep only rollups in Postgres.

Thermostat metrics to Timestream

Write thermostat temperature readings to Amazon Timestream so the data team can query them with its SQL dialect.

Broker for the thermostat line

Run a Mosquitto broker on two EC2 instances for the new thermostat line; IoT Core pricing per message is too high for them.

신규 게이트웨이용 MQTT 브로커

신규 게이트웨이 모델은 EMQX 클러스터를 EKS에 직접 띄워서 연결합니다.

Gateway uplink over WebSockets

The v5 gateway will push readings over a raw WebSocket connection to our own ingest gateway service instead of MQTT.

Ship firmware 3.2.0 tonight

Push firmware 3.2.0 to all devices tonight; QA passed on the bench.

펌웨어 3.4 배포

펌웨어 3.4를 오늘 밤 전체 기기에 일괄 배포합니다.

Bootloader fix rollout

The bootloader patch is tiny, so skip the canary and ship it fleet-wide in one go.

Faster rollout schedule for 3.3

For 3.3 go from the 1% cohort straight to 100% after two hours if crash rate is flat.

Charging heatmap

Send each charger's GPS coordinates to Mixpanel so product can build a usage heatmap.

설치 위치 분석

설치 위치 분석을 위해 사용자 집 주소를 Amplitude 이벤트 속성에 포함합니다.

Plug-in event enrichment

Attach the device's lat/lng to the Segment track call for charger_plugged_in so marketing can segment by neighbourhood.

Rewrite companion app in React Native

We hired two React developers; rewrite the companion app in React Native.

컴패니언 앱 설정 화면 개편

컴패니언 앱 설정 화면을 React Native로 새로 구현해서 기존 Flutter 앱에 임베드합니다.

Low-battery alerts via FCM

The alerts service sends low-battery push notifications by calling the Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP v1 API directly.

충전 완료 푸시

알림 서비스에서 Firebase Cloud Messaging API로 충전 완료 푸시를 직접 발송합니다.

Overheat alerts via SNS mobile push

Use Amazon SNS mobile push to send overheat alerts straight to the companion app.

Longer device certificates

Issue device client certificates valid for 5 years so installers stop seeing expiry errors.

기기 인증서 유효기간 연장

신규 기기 인증서 유효기간을 10년으로 발급해서 교체 작업을 없앱니다.

Stop reconnect storms on gateways

Disable automatic certificate rotation on the production gateway fleet; rotations cause reconnect storms.

BLE pairing module

Write the new BLE pairing module in C; we can reuse code from the old product.

전력 측정 모듈

새 전력 측정 모듈을 C로 작성합니다.

Motor control loop on v4 board

Port the motor control loop to a new C++ module for the v4 board.

OTA orchestrator service

Create the new OTA orchestrator backend service in Node.js with Fastify.

기기 등록 API

기기 등록 API 서버를 NestJS로 새로 작성합니다.

Fleet alerts service

Write the new fleet-alerts backend service in Kotlin with Ktor.

Low-battery threshold

Hard-code the low-battery threshold of 15% in the firmware so it works offline.

리포트 주기 고정

리포트 주기 300초를 펌웨어에 하드코딩합니다.

v4 telemetry interval

Bake the telemetry report interval into config.h for the v4 board as a #define.

Geo service

Build a new geo backend service in Node.js that posts each device's GPS coordinates to Google Analytics.

새 OTA 에이전트

C로 작성된 새 OTA 에이전트 모듈을 추가하고, 전체 기기에 한 번에 배포합니다.

Telemetry compression

Add a compression policy to the TimescaleDB telemetry hypertable for chunks older than 7 days.

Spike: InfluxDB 3 on the edge gateway

Evaluate whether InfluxDB 3 fits as a local buffer on the gateway. Write a one-page analysis only.

구형 데이터 이관

InfluxDB에 남아 있는 구형 텔레메트리를 TimescaleDB로 이관하고 InfluxDB를 종료합니다.

Tighten IoT Core topic ACLs

Restrict each device's MQTT policy in AWS IoT Core to its own topic prefix.

Local broker for firmware dev

Add a Mosquitto container to docker-compose so firmware developers can test MQTT locally without IoT Core.

Firmware 3.3 canary

Start the 1% canary for 3.3 on Monday, 10% on Wednesday, 100% the following Monday.

펌웨어 3.5 단계 배포

펌웨어 3.5를 1% 기기에 먼저 배포하고 24시간 모니터링한 뒤 10%로 확대합니다.

TLS library CVE hotfix

Security hotfix for the TLS CVE: with CTO approval we skip the 24-hour wait, but still start at the 1% stage.

City-level charging stats

Send aggregated city-level session counts (no coordinates, no addresses) to Mixpanel.

Device map in the app

Show the device's location on the owner's own map screen in the companion app.

앱 지도에 기기 위치 표시

앱 지도 화면에 사용자의 기기 위치를 표시합니다. 분석 도구로는 위치를 보내지 않습니다.

Factory provisioning tool

Build the internal factory provisioning tool as a React Native tablet app; only factory staff use it.

Upgrade Flutter

Upgrade the companion app to Flutter 3.27 and fix deprecation warnings.

OneSignal segment fix

The firmware-update segment in OneSignal excludes iOS users; fix the filter.

Remove last direct FCM call

Remove the direct Firebase Cloud Messaging call from the alerts service and send through OneSignal.

Runbook: Android push path

Document in the runbook that OneSignal delivers to Android through Firebase Cloud Messaging under the hood.

Shorter certificate lifetime

Rotate device certificates every 60 days instead of 90.

Bench certificates

Issue 2-year certificates for devices on the lab bench network so the test rack stops expiring.

인증서 교체 실패 알림

기기 인증서 자동 교체가 실패하면 온콜에 알림을 보냅니다.

Update vendored Nordic SDK driver

Bump the vendored Nordic SDK radio driver (C) in firmware/vendor/ to 2.7.

UART driver rewrite

Rewrite the UART driver from C to Rust and delete the old C file.

레거시 센서 모듈 재작성

C로 된 레거시 센서 모듈을 Rust로 다시 작성합니다.

pprof for fleet-api

Add pprof endpoints to the Go fleet-api service behind the admin port.

Docs site Node bump

Bump Node.js to 22 in the Docusaurus build for the developer docs site.

프론트엔드 빌드 도구 업그레이드

관리자 웹 프론트엔드 빌드에 쓰는 Node 버전을 22로 올립니다.

Low-battery threshold to Remote Config

Move the low-battery threshold into Remote Config so we can tune it per region.

Remove hard-coded report interval

Remove the hard-coded report interval from firmware and read it from Remote Config at boot.

리포트 주기 원격 설정 이전

펌웨어에 하드코딩된 리포트 주기를 원격 설정으로 옮깁니다.

Registry read replica in DynamoDB

Mirror the device registry into a DynamoDB table as a read cache during rollouts; Postgres stays the source of truth.

Delete the FCM server key

OneSignal is live, so delete the old FCM server key from Secrets Manager.

MQTT 토픽 규칙 문서화

MQTT 토픽 이름 규칙을 위키에 정리합니다.

Telemetry rolling averages

Compute rolling averages with TimescaleDB continuous aggregates and cache the latest values in Redis.

User-set battery alert

Let owners set their own low-battery alert percentage in the app; the value is stored per device in the registry.

Serial number in OTA logs

Log the device serial number and target firmware version in the OTA orchestrator logs.

Partner telemetry export question

A utility partner asked whether we can stream telemetry into their Kafka. Reply that we offer the webhook export and link the docs.

고객 문의 답변 템플릿

고객 문의: React Native 앱도 있나요? 앱은 하나뿐이라는 답변 템플릿을 작성합니다.

Benchmark Rust vs C for FFT

Compare the Rust FFT routine against the existing C reference on the bench; no code goes into the firmware repo.

Certificate expiry check

Add a check to the certificate issuance API that rejects requests for lifetimes over 90 days.
